summary_en: This study tests Orca-Q, an engineered donor graft, in people getting allogeneic stem cell transplant for blood cancers. The conditions listed are acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplastic syndromes, mixed phenotype acute leukemia, and acute lymphoblastic leukemia. The record does not state how Orca-Q is given or how long or how often it is given. The study evaluates safety, tolerability, and efficacy, and it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa Orca-Q, un injerto de donante modificado, en personas que reciben un trasplante alogénico de células madre por cánceres de la sangre. Las afecciones enumeradas son leucemia mieloide aguda, síndromes mielodisplásicos, leucemia aguda de fenotipo mixto y leucemia linfoblástica aguda. El registro no indica cómo se administra Orca-Q ni durante cuánto tiempo o con qué frecuencia. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia, y es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Ages 12 to 78 years; some transplant arms have an upper limit of 65 years.
Acute myeloid, lymphoblastic, or mixed phenotype leukemia, or high or very high risk MDS, in remission or with 10% or fewer blasts in marrow.
Indicated for allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Matched to a 8/8 or 7/8 related or unrelated donor, or a related haploidentical donor.
Kidney, heart, lung, liver function and performance score within limits set for each arm.
not_for: Currently receiving immunosuppressive therapy, other than disease-specific therapy or steroids at 10 mg/day or less.
Planned donor lymphocyte infusion or planned T cell depletion.
Positive anti-donor HLA antibodies against a mismatched allele in the selected donor.
Uncontrolled infection or autoimmune disease, HIV, HTLV, hepatitis B or C positivity, recent other cancer, myelofibrosis history, pregnancy or breastfeeding.
